headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. The Washington Nationals took down the Arizona Diamondbacks in a doubleheader, winning 5-3 and 10-7. CJ Abrams led the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs in the first game, while James Wood, Dylan Crews, Abrams, and Connelly Early contributed to the win in the second game.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Cody Bellinger (New York Yankees), Shea Langeliers (Athletics), Mike Paredes (Minnesota Twins), Josh Jung (Texas Rangers), Spencer Arrighetti (Houston Astros), Juan Soto (New York Mets), Shawn Armstrong (Cleveland Guardians), and Tanner Banks (Philadelphia Phillies). The status of these players may impact their teams' lineups and rotations.

The Washington Nationals made a significant trade, acquiring Connelly Early from the Boston Red Sox in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead. The Philadelphia Phillies also made a trade, acquiring CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Ron Marinaccio to the Pirates from the San Diego Padres for Future Considerations, while the Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 3-2. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win, while Clayton Beeter closed out the game with a save.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Angels 9-2**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels, winning 9-2 behind a strong performance from Robbie Ray, who earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 5 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease. Cease pitched 9.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Guardians in Close Match**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 1-0 victory over the Cleveland Guardians in a low-scoring game. Impact performances came from Parker Messick and Drew Rasmussen on the mound, while Chandler Simpson stood out at the plate.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 10-7**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 7-10 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with multiple players contributing to the win. Impact hitters for the Nationals included James Wood, Dylan Crews, CJ Abrams, and Connelly Early.

top_news.title: **Yankees Place Cody Bellinger on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Cody Bellinger, the left fielder for the New York Yankees, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Curtis Mead in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead.
